scope: formula-to-code and complete seven-channel supervisor method contract

formula_to_code.plain_language: MultiPath assigns a probability to each anchor-defined future and predicts a continuous Gaussian correction around every anchor.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: The primary paper models target predictions as multimodal Gaussian/LTV modes in Eq. (5) and uses MultiPath in its CARLA studies (Sec. IV-B).
formula_to_code.implementation: The online interface supplies a target-centred raster and past state history; four-input variants additionally receive an aligned six-token ego-target interaction sequence and mask. The decoder splits the output into J logits and JxT trajectory parameters, applies softmax to logits, and adds residual means to fixed anchors.

code.landmark: raster, past state and optional interaction sequence construction

formula_to_code.plain_language: Every mode and future instant has its own rotated 2-by-2 position covariance. The model does not predict covariance between different future instants.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: Eq. (5) supplies Gaussian process noise per mode and time; the exact MultiPath output parameterisation is an implementation detail.
formula_to_code.implementation: Raw width is J*T*5+J; each [mode,time] emits dx,dy,two log-scale values and one rotation, producing shape [...,J,T,2,2]. No cross-time covariance tensor is constructed.

formula_to_code.manuscript_formula: L_train=-log pi_{j*}+(1/|V|) sum_{t in V}[-log N(y_t;mu_{j*,t},Sigma_{j*,t})]+const,  j*=argmin_j ADE(anchor_j,y)
formula_to_code.plain_language: Training first assigns each example to its nearest anchor, then learns that anchor's probability and Gaussian residual. This is a hard-assignment training loss, not the all-mode mixture likelihood used for testing.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: MultiPath [8] is the paper's predictor; this project's fine-tuning loss is repository-specific.
formula_to_code.implementation: Nearest anchor is selected over valid labels; cross-entropy and selected-mode Gaussian NLL are averaged over valid time steps.

formula_to_code.manuscript_formula: NLL_test=-(1/T) log sum_j pi_j prod_t N(y_t;mu_{j,t},Sigma_{j,t})
formula_to_code.plain_language: Held-out scoring rewards a model only when its complete probability-weighted mixture explains the entire future trajectory.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: Consistent with the multimodal distribution assumed in Eq. (5); the rollout-macro evaluation is repository-specific.
formula_to_code.implementation: Per-mode log densities are summed across time, combined once with log mode probabilities by log-sum-exp, then divided by horizon. This differs deliberately from training's nearest-anchor loss.

formula_to_code.plain_language: For each predicted manoeuvre, target motion is represented as a time-varying linear Gaussian process that the controller can propagate.
formula_to_code.implementation: The optimiser holds per-target, per-mode, per-step T, c and 2-by-2 covariance-square-root parameters.

formula_to_code.plain_language: h is the nominal branch command, M reacts to ego-model disturbance, and K reacts to deviation of the target from its predicted mean.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: Primary paper Eq. (11), stacked in Eqs. (21)-(23).
formula_to_code.implementation: CasADi variables are built and returned as [h,M,K], with branch sharing before the prediction tree splits.

formula_to_code.plain_language: The sign convention is defined generically: a non-negative safety margin means collision-free. The code's second-order-cone form is an inner approximation of this event.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: Primary paper Eqs. (6d), (12)-(15): the safe event is written with a greater-than-or-equal sign.
formula_to_code.implementation: The collision linearisation creates SOC vectors z,y and imposes ca.soc(z,y)>0. Manuscript exposition must not reverse the safe-margin sign.

formula_to_code.manuscript_formula: min_{h,M,K,beta} sum_{j in J_active} pi_j J_j + J_shared
formula_to_code.plain_language: After the policy tree branches, every complete joint MultiPath mode weights its own tracking and control cost by its normalized probability. Before branching there is one shared policy and its cost has unit weight.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: The source formulation minimizes probability-weighted expected branch cost in Eqs. (6a) and (19).
formula_to_code.implementation: The branch loop collects every branch_cost and the production helper forms their self.probs-weighted expectation. A single unbranched policy uses weight one; shared slack and corridor penalties are added once outside the branch expectation. Old unweighted runtime identifiers are rejected.

code.landmark: objective semantic identifier and contract hash
production expected-cost helper receives all active branch costs and probabilities

formula_to_code.manuscript_formula: sum_j pi_j beta_j >= beta_req,  r_j approximately Phi^{-1}(beta_j)
formula_to_code.plain_language: Mode probabilities influence how the allowed collision risk is distributed: likely modes carry more weight in the total probability-of-safety budget.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: Primary paper Eqs. (15a), (16)-(18), with eta_j=Phi^{-1}(r_j) and a probability-weighted safety budget.
formula_to_code.implementation: mmrisk_std is the tightening variable r-like/eta-like scalar; mmrisk_prob approximates beta through affine inverse-CDF constraints. The same normalized self.probs vector used by the objective weights the total adaptive-risk constraint.

formula_to_code.plain_language: The optimiser plans all branches but applies only the first command, then resolves after receiving the next state and prediction.
formula_to_code.implementation: The first two entries of the root h policy are extracted as u_control.

formula_to_code.manuscript_formula: q*=argmin_{q on ego route} distance(q, target motion line)
formula_to_code.plain_language: The give-way conflict location follows the actual curved ego route and target travel line; it is not a fixed coordinate and it changes with route geometry.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: Scenario-specific extension; the source paper describes an unprotected left turn but does not prescribe this Town05 geometry routine.
formula_to_code.implementation: Every ego-route point is projected onto the target line and the closest projection is selected.

formula_to_code.manuscript_formula: Delta t_CARLA=1/20=0.05 s; N=10, Delta t_SMPC=0.2 s; horizon=2.0 s
formula_to_code.plain_language: CARLA advances at 20 simulator frames per second, while each ten-step SMPC prediction spans two seconds at 0.2 seconds per optimisation step. Simulator frame rate is not the same quantity as SMPC horizon discretisation or measured solve frequency.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: The primary paper reports dt=0.2 s for CARLA experiments and real-time operation; it does not license calling this repository's optimiser a 10 Hz loop without timing evidence.
formula_to_code.implementation: Scenario JSON fixes fps=20; CarlaSyncMode uses 1/fps; the frozen give-way tuning fixes N=10 and dt=0.2.

formula_to_code.plain_language: The predictor supplies a distribution, risk allocation changes chance-constraint tightening, SMPC proposes a nominal command, and the complete supervisor authority mapping may change solver inputs, bypass the solve, replace the action, or alter state used next time. Monitor-only computes the same candidates but blocks them from factual actuation.
formula_to_code.paper_basis: Prediction-to-SMPC follows the primary paper; A_S is this project's seven-channel rule-based authority layer.
formula_to_code.implementation: Authority gating is applied to pre-solver reference/cost/bypass channels and to post-solver action/state channels. A masking estimand therefore needs aligned same-state command separation before and after the identical authority mapping; trajectory similarity alone is insufficient.

supervisor_channels.trigger: rule-aware yield or release-recovery profile requests a different reference
supervisor_channels.action: changes feasible reference states/inputs, including speed and acceleration profile

supervisor_channels.position: after reference shaping, before SMPC update
supervisor_channels.action: replaces previous-solution linearisation with a reference-horizon slice

supervisor_channels.trigger: lane-entry heading cost enabled and ego lies inside configured goal window/error guard
supervisor_channels.position: before SMPC solve during cost-profile construction
supervisor_channels.action: adds horizon-varying heading-error weights to each active branch cost

supervisor_channels.trigger: _rule_yield_smpc_bypass_reason returns a reason and authority is enabled
supervisor_channels.action: skips the SMPC solve and uses the rule-yield candidate path

supervisor_channels.trigger: rule-aware post-solver candidate differs from nominal solver command/speed
supervisor_channels.position: after solver or bypass candidate, before low-level control
supervisor_channels.action: selects nominal or rule candidate acceleration, steering and desired speed according to action-filter mode

supervisor_channels.trigger: post-action supervisor state differs from neutral free-drive state
supervisor_channels.position: after action arbitration, persisted across control steps
supervisor_channels.action: updates seen/active/recovery-count/last-acceleration state used by later release and recovery decisions

supervisor_channels.trigger: executed command differs from the nominal solver command
supervisor_channels.position: after action arbitration, before the next SMPC update
supervisor_channels.action: writes executed u0 to control_prev, changing next-step rate constraints and warm-history semantics

mandatory_corrections.objective: Write the implemented post-branch objective as sum_j pi_j J_j plus shared penalties; the unbranched policy has unit weight.
mandatory_corrections.probability_use: One normalized joint-mode probability vector weights both expected branch cost and the adaptive-risk budget.
mandatory_corrections.covariance: Use one 2x2 covariance per mode and time; do not imply cross-time covariance.
mandatory_corrections.nll: Distinguish nearest-anchor training NLL from all-mode held-out trajectory-mixture NLL.
mandatory_corrections.conflict_geometry: Conflict point is route-versus-target-line geometry, not a fixed coordinate or 12 m zone.
mandatory_corrections.timing: CARLA is 20 Hz; N=10 and dt=0.2 s define a 2 s SMPC horizon; solve frequency requires timing evidence.
